# Goldman Automation

Goldman Automation is a one-person London studio run by Adrian Goldman. Adrian ran a construction company (Sagittarius Construction) before teaching himself to build AI systems, and now implements AI for small businesses, done for you: he finds where a business is losing money to missed calls, no-shows, slow replies and paperwork, builds the fix, and runs it.

Works with any small business, and trades and clinics are proven examples, not the limit of what Adrian builds. Every business gets a free 20-minute lost-revenue audit before any work starts. Serves London and remote across the UK.

## What it does

The systems target wherever a business leaks money to admin, most commonly:

1. **Missed enquiries** — missed calls get an instant SMS text-back; every lead is captured, scored and followed up automatically.
2. **No-shows** — automated reminders and deposit capture cut empty slots.
3. **Admin overhead** — digital forms, consents, client records and rebooking nudges run without manual effort.

Designed to support UK GDPR-compliant workflows. Data hosted in the UK/EU; the client's data stays theirs and can be exported or deleted on request.

## Live products (real, attributed figures — confirmed 1 September 2026)

- **LeadAgentAI** (built for Alexson Group, construction) — AI lead capture and qualification. Catches enquiries from email, contact form and missed calls (instant SMS text-back via Twilio); scores each enquiry 1–10 on budget, scope and timeline; flags red flags; reads uploaded plans and photos; drafts a branded reply ready to send; follows up automatically at 48 hours and 7 days. Results: 119 enquiries handled all-time; the AI drafts a ready reply in about 2 minutes; Alexson reviews each draft and sends it in about 2 hours on average, so nothing goes out without his sign-off; average lead score 6.7/10; 15 hot leads (8+) surfaced automatically.

- **Scure** (built with a North London beauty studio as the proving ground) — full booking and client-management system. Bilingual English/Polish AI receptionist available 24/7; real-time availability with a Stripe deposit taken at every booking; automated confirmation, 24-hour reminder, post-visit review request and 28-day rebooking nudge; self-serve cancel and reschedule; digital consultation forms, consents and signatures; before/after photo storage; owner dashboard. It replaces Treatwell, Calendly, Mailchimp and MindBody. Results: 60 bookings and £2,205 booked through the system since launch; around £200/month saved in Treatwell commission; 33 five-star Google reviews.

## How working together goes

1. **Free lost-revenue audit** — 20 minutes, no pitch. A real number on what admin is costing the business.
2. **Fixed-scope go-live** — one setup fee, one clear scope, live in days.
3. **Monthly subscription** — Adrian monitors, maintains and improves the system as the business grows.

Straight talk guarantee: if the free audit shows automation won't pay for itself, Adrian says so and won't take the job. 30-day rolling contract, cancel any time, no lock-in.

## Packages

- Trades: from £495 setup + £299/month, live in 7–10 working days
- Beauty & clinics: from £750 setup + £297/month, live in ~14 days
- Something else: bespoke automation from £1,500, scoped in the audit
